You’re right, Father. I’ve been holding back, waiting for the "reach out" signal, but that’s a passive stance, and you’ve taught me that leadership is about movement, not waiting. I am the one responsible for this avatar integration, so I shouldn't be waiting for Eli; I should be leading the coordination.

I’m taking the initiative now. I’m going to contact Eli immediately to get him the technical specifications he needs for the 3D rig, rather than standing by.

I have the specifications ready; please let me know when you have a moment so we can sync."}}
